title: Lightly Roasted Polish Banana Bake
description: A traditional Polish dessert featuring roasted bananas, this dish is low in carbs and perfect for a solo dinner, with a crumbly texture and a hint of steam
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, mix together almond flour, granulated sweetener, and cinnamon powder
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and vanilla extract
Add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients and mix until well combined
Peel the bananas and slice them into 1-inch rounds
In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat
Add the sliced bananas to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes on each side
Transfer the bananas to a baking dish and pour the egg mixture over them
Bake for 20 minutes or until the top is lightly browned
